_about: The asset ledger (docs/vision/asset-ledger.md). Every picture under assets/ with its grade: KEEP may go into a kit or region build, REWORK must be redone first, RETIRE has no place in the new world. Written by scripts/art/asset_ledger.py --build; `eye` verdicts are written by hand and survive a rebuild. Checked by scripts/check-assets.cjs (npm run check:assets).

grades.KEEP: fits the newest standard on every check
grades.REWORK: the subject stays; redo the art first
grades.RETIRE: no place in the new world

fix.redraw: a new drawing (detail, size, footprint, logic, light, speckle)
fix.repaint: the same drawing on the house ramps (colours off the ramps or over budget)
fix.outline: only the outline step: the material's edge tone instead of one ink, no doubling

rules.why: the world canvas (PR #123, #126): tiles cut by world_canvas.py from the old zones' grounds, which retire; a plane is re-graded when its region is rebuilt on the soft grid and its tiles are cut from the new ground
